verses.original: שׁוֹטְט֞וּ בְּחוּצ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וּרְאוּ־ נָ֤א וּדְעוּ֙ וּבַקְשׁ֣וּ בִרְחוֹבוֹתֶ֔יהָ אִם־ תִּמְצְא֣וּ אִ֔ישׁ אִם־ יֵ֛שׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אֱמוּנָ֑ה וְאֶסְלַ֖ח לָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: šō·wṭ·ṭū bə·ḥū·ṣō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim ū·rə·’ū- nā ū·ḏə·‘ū ū·ḇaq·šū ḇir·ḥō·w·ḇō·w·ṯe·hā ’im- tim·ṣə·’ū ’îš ’im- yêš ‘ō·śeh miš·pāṭ mə·ḇaq·qêš ’ĕ·mū·nāh wə·’es·laḥ lāh
verses.literal: Go up and down the streets of Jerusalem Look now and take note search her squares If you can find a single person . . . . . . [anyone] who acts justly [anyone] who seeks the truth then I will forgive [the city]

verses.original: וְאִ֥ם יֹאמֵ֑רוּ לָכֵ֥ן יְהֹוָ֖ה חַי־ יִשָּׁבֵֽעוּ׃ לַשֶּׁ֖קֶר
verses.transliteration: wə·’im yō·mê·rū lā·ḵên Yah·weh ḥay- yiš·šā·ḇê·‘ū laš·še·qer
verses.literal: Although they say . . . As surely as the LORD lives they are swearing falsely . . .

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֗ה הֲל֣וֹא עֵינֶיךָ֮ לֶאֱמוּנָה֒ הִכִּ֤יתָה אֹתָם֙ וְֽלֹא־ חָ֔לוּ כִּלִּיתָ֕ם מֵאֲנ֖וּ קַ֣חַת מוּסָ֑ר פְנֵיהֶם֙ חִזְּק֤וּ מִסֶּ֔לַע מֵאֲנ֖וּ לָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh hă·lō·w ‘ê·ne·ḵā le·’ĕ·mū·nāh hik·kî·ṯāh ’ō·ṯām wə·lō- ḥā·lū kil·lî·ṯām mê·’ă·nū qa·ḥaṯ mū·sār p̄ə·nê·hem ḥiz·zə·qū mis·se·la‘ mê·’ă·nū lā·šūḇ
verses.literal: O LORD do not Your eyes [look] for truth You struck them - but they felt no pain You finished them off but they refused to accept discipline They have made their faces harder than stone and refused to repent

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי הֵ֑ם אַךְ־ דַּלִּ֖ים נוֹאֲל֕וּ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָדְעוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֔ה מִשְׁפַּ֖ט אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’ā·mar·tî hêm ’aḵ- dal·lîm nō·w·’ă·lū kî lō yā·ḏə·‘ū de·reḵ Yah·weh miš·paṭ ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem
verses.literal: Then I said They are only the poor they have played the fool for they do not know the way of the LORD the justice of their God

verses.original: אֵֽלֲכָה־ לִּ֤י אֶל־ הַגְּדֹלִים֙ וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה אוֹתָ֔ם כִּ֣י הֵ֗מָּה יָדְעוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֔ה מִשְׁפַּ֖ט אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם אַ֣ךְ הֵ֤מָּה יַחְדָּו֙ שָׁ֣בְרוּ עֹ֔ל נִתְּק֖וּ מוֹסֵרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·lă·ḵāh- lî ’el- hag·gə·ḏō·lîm wa·’ă·ḏab·bə·rāh ’ō·w·ṯām kî hêm·māh yā·ḏə·‘ū de·reḵ Yah·weh miš·paṭ ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem ’aḵ hêm·māh yaḥ·dāw šā·ḇə·rū ‘ōl nit·tə·qū mō·w·sê·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: I will go to the powerful and speak to them Surely they know the way of the LORD the justice of their God But they too with one accord had broken the yoke and torn off the chains

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּן֩ אַרְיֵ֜ה מִיַּ֗עַר הִכָּ֨ם זְאֵ֤ב עֲרָבוֹת֙ יְשָׁדְדֵ֔ם נָמֵ֤ר שֹׁקֵד֙ עַל־ עָ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם כָּל־ הַיּוֹצֵ֥א מֵהֵ֖נָּה יִטָּרֵ֑ף כִּ֤י פִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֔ם רַבּוּ֙ מְשֻׁבוֹתֵיהֶם׃ עָצְמ֖וּ
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ’ar·yêh mî·ya·‘ar hik·kām zə·’êḇ ‘ă·rā·ḇō·wṯ yə·šā·ḏə·ḏêm nā·mêr šō·qêḏ ‘al- ‘ā·rê·hem kāl- hay·yō·w·ṣê mê·hên·nāh yiṭ·ṭā·rêp̄ kî piš·‘ê·hem rab·bū mə·šu·ḇō·ṯē·hɛm ‘ā·ṣə·mū
verses.literal: Therefore . . . a lion from the forest will strike them down a wolf from the desert will ravage them A leopard will lie in wait near their cities [and] everyone who ventures out . . . will be torn to pieces For their rebellious acts are many [and] their unfaithful deeds are numerous

verses.original: אֵ֤י לָזֹאת֙ אֶסְלוֹחַ לָ֔ךְ בָּנַ֣יִךְ עֲזָב֔וּנִי וַיִּשָּׁבְע֖וּ בְּלֹ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים וָאַשְׂבִּ֤עַ אוֹתָם֙ וַיִּנְאָ֔פוּ יִתְגֹּדָֽדוּ׃ וּבֵ֥ית זוֹנָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ’ê lā·zōṯ ʾɛs·lō·aḥ lå̄ḵ bā·na·yiḵ ‘ă·zā·ḇū·nî way·yiš·šā·ḇə·‘ū bə·lō ’ĕ·lō·hîm wā·’aś·bi·a‘ ’ō·w·ṯām way·yin·’ā·p̄ū yiṯ·gō·ḏā·ḏū ū·ḇêṯ zō·w·nāh
verses.literal: Why . . . should I forgive you . . . Your children have forsaken Me and sworn by [gods] that are not gods I satisfied their needs yet they committed adultery and assembled at the houses of prostitutes

verses.original: הָי֑וּ מְיֻזָּנִ֖ים מַשְׁכִּ֣ים סוּסִ֥ים אִ֛ישׁ יִצְהָֽלוּ׃ אֶל־ רֵעֵ֖הוּ אֵ֥שֶׁת
verses.transliteration: hā·yū mə·yuz·zā·nîm maš·kîm sū·sîm ’îš yiṣ·hā·lū ’el- rê·‘ê·hū ’ê·šeṯ
verses.literal: They are well-fed lusty stallions each neighing after his neighbor’s wife

verses.original: לוֹא־ אֶפְקֹ֖ד הַֽעַל־ אֵ֥לֶּה נְאֻם־ יְהֹוָ֑ה וְאִם֙ לֹ֥א תִתְנַקֵּ֖ם נַפְשִֽׁי׃ס בְּג֣וֹי אֲשֶׁר־ כָּזֶ֔ה
verses.transliteration: lō·w- ’ep̄·qōḏ ha·‘al- ’êl·leh nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·’im lō ṯiṯ·naq·qêm nap̄·šî bə·ḡō·w ’ă·šer- kā·zeh
verses.literal: Should I not punish them for these things declares the LORD Should I not avenge Myself on such a nation - as this

verses.original: עֲל֤וּ בְשָׁרוֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ וְשַׁחֵ֔תוּ אַֽל־ וְכָלָ֖ה תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ הָסִ֙ירוּ֙ נְטִ֣ישׁוֹתֶ֔יהָ כִּ֛י הֵֽמָּה׃ ל֥וֹא לַיהוָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·lū ḇə·šā·rō·w·ṯe·hā wə·ša·ḥê·ṯū ’al- wə·ḵā·lāh ta·‘ă·śū hā·sî·rū nə·ṭî·šō·w·ṯe·hā kî hêm·māh lō·w Yah·weh
verses.literal: Go up through her vineyards and ravage them but do not finish them off . . . Strip off her branches for they do not belong to the LORD

verses.original: כִּי֩ בֵּ֧ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וּבֵ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה בָג֨וֹד בָּגְד֜וּ בִּ֗י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh ḇā·ḡō·wḏ bā·ḡə·ḏū bî nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have been utterly unfaithful . . . to Me declares the LORD

verses.original: כִּֽחֲשׁוּ֙ בַּיהוָ֔ה וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ ה֑וּא לֹא־ רָעָ֔ה וְלֹא־ תָב֤וֹא עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ ל֥וֹא נִרְאֶֽה׃ וְחֶ֥רֶב וְרָעָ֖ב
verses.transliteration: ki·ḥă·šū Yah·weh way·yō·mə·rū hū lō- rā·‘āh wə·lō- ṯā·ḇō·w ‘ā·lê·nū lō·w nir·’eh wə·ḥe·reḇ wə·rā·‘āḇ
verses.literal: They have lied about the LORD and said He will not do anything harm will not come to us we will not see sword or famine

verses.original: וְהַנְּבִיאִים֙ יִֽהְי֣וּ לְר֔וּחַ וְהַדִּבֵּ֖ר אֵ֣ין בָּהֶ֑ם כֹּ֥ה יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה לָהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nə·ḇî·’îm yih·yū lə·rū·aḥ wə·had·dib·bêr ’ên bā·hem kōh yê·‘ā·śeh lā·hem
verses.literal: The prophets are but wind for the word [is] not in them So let [their own predictions] befall them

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י צְבָא֔וֹת אָמַ֤ר יַ֚עַן דַּבֶּרְכֶ֔ם אֶת־ הַזֶּ֑ה הִנְנִ֣י הַדָּבָ֖ר נֹתֵן֩ דְּבָרַ֨י לְאֵ֗שׁ בְּפִ֜יךָ הַזֶּ֛ה וְהָעָ֥ם עֵצִ֖ים וַאֲכָלָֽתַם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ā·mar ya·‘an dab·ber·ḵem ’eṯ- haz·zeh hin·nî had·dā·ḇār nō·ṯên də·ḇā·ray lə·’êš bə·p̄î·ḵā haz·zeh wə·hā·‘ām ‘ê·ṣîm wa·’ă·ḵā·lā·ṯam
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD God of Hosts says Because you have spoken - this . . . word I will make My words a fire in your mouth and this people the wood it consumes

verses.original: הִנְנִ֣י מֵבִיא֩ מִמֶּרְחָ֛ק גּ֧וֹי עֲלֵיכֶ֨ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם־ יְהֹוָ֑ה ה֗וּא אֵיתָ֣ן גּ֣וֹי׀ מֵעוֹלָם֙ ה֔וּא גּ֤וֹי גּ֚וֹי לְשֹׁנ֔וֹ לֹא־ תֵדַ֣ע מַה־ יְדַבֵּֽר׃ וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁמַ֖ע
verses.transliteration: hin·nî mê·ḇî mim·mer·ḥāq gō·w ‘ă·lê·ḵem bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um- Yah·weh hū ’ê·ṯān gō·w mê·‘ō·w·lām hū gō·w gō·w lə·šō·nōw lō- ṯê·ḏa‘ mah- yə·ḏab·bêr wə·lō ṯiš·ma‘
verses.literal: Behold I am bringing a distant nation against you O house of Israel declares the LORD It is an established nation an ancient . . . nation a nation whose language you do not know and whose speech . . . you do not understand

verses.original: אַשְׁפָּת֖וֹ פָּת֑וּחַ כְּקֶ֣בֶר כֻּלָּ֖ם גִּבּוֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·pā·ṯōw pā·ṯū·aḥ kə·qe·ḇer kul·lām gib·bō·w·rîm
verses.literal: Their quivers are like open graves they are all mighty men

verses.original: וְאָכַ֨ל קְצִֽירְךָ֜ וְלַחְמֶ֗ךָ יֹאכְלוּ֙ בָּנֶ֣יךָ וּבְנוֹתֶ֔יךָ יֹאכַ֤ל צֹאנְךָ֙ וּבְקָרֶ֔ךָ יֹאכַ֥ל גַּפְנְךָ֖ וּתְאֵנָתֶ֑ךָ בֶּחָֽרֶב׃ יְרֹשֵׁ֞שׁ מִבְצָרֶ֗יךָ עָרֵ֣י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה בּוֹטֵ֥חַ בָּהֵ֖נָּה
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḵal qə·ṣî·rə·ḵā wə·laḥ·me·ḵā yō·ḵə·lū bā·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·ḵā yō·ḵal ṣō·nə·ḵā ū·ḇə·qā·re·ḵā yō·ḵal gap̄·nə·ḵā ū·ṯə·’ê·nā·ṯe·ḵā be·ḥā·reḇ yə·rō·šêš miḇ·ṣā·re·ḵā ‘ā·rê ’ă·šer ’at·tāh bō·w·ṭê·aḥ bā·hên·nāh
verses.literal: They will devour your harvest and food they will consume your sons and daughters they will eat up your flocks and herds they will feed on your vines and fig trees With the sword they will destroy the fortified cities in which you trust . . .

verses.original: וְגַ֛ם הָהֵ֖מָּה בַּיָּמִ֥ים נְאֻם־ יְהֹוָ֑ה לֹֽא־ אֶעֱשֶׂ֥ה כָּלָֽה׃ אִתְּכֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam hā·hêm·māh bay·yā·mîm nə·’um- Yah·weh lō- ’e·‘ĕ·śeh kā·lāh ’it·tə·ḵem
verses.literal: Yet even in those days declares the LORD I will not make a full end of you

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ כִּ֣י תֹאמְר֔וּ תַּ֣חַת מֶ֗ה יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ לָ֖נוּ אֶת־ עָשָׂ֨ה כָּל־ אֵ֑לֶּה וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר עֲזַבְתֶּ֤ם אוֹתִי֙ וַתַּעַבְד֞וּ נֵכָר֙ אֱלֹהֵ֤י בְּאַרְצְכֶ֔ם כֵּ֚ן תַּעַבְד֣וּ זָרִ֔ים בְּאֶ֖רֶץ לֹ֥א לָכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî ṯō·mə·rū ta·ḥaṯ meh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū lā·nū ’eṯ- ‘ā·śāh kāl- ’êl·leh wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ka·’ă·šer ‘ă·zaḇ·tem ’ō·w·ṯî wat·ta·‘aḇ·ḏū nê·ḵār ’ĕ·lō·hê bə·’ar·ṣə·ḵem kên ta·‘aḇ·ḏū zā·rîm bə·’e·reṣ lō lā·ḵem
verses.literal: And when the people ask For what offense has the LORD our God - done all these things to us You are to tell them Just as you have forsaken Me and served foreign gods in your land so will you serve foreigners in a land that is not your own

verses.original: הַגִּ֥ידוּ זֹ֖את בְּבֵ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְהַשְׁמִיע֥וּהָ בִיהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gî·ḏū zōṯ bə·ḇêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·haš·mî·‘ū·hā ḇî·hū·ḏāh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Declare this in the house of Jacob and proclaim it in Judah -

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־ נָ֣א זֹ֔את סָכָ֖ל וְאֵ֣ין לֵ֑ב עַ֥ם עֵינַ֤יִם לָהֶם֙ וְלֹ֣א יִרְא֔וּ אָזְנַ֥יִם לָהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁמָֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū- nā zōṯ sā·ḵāl wə·’ên lêḇ ‘am ‘ê·na·yim lā·hem wə·lō yir·’ū ’ā·zə·na·yim lā·hem wə·lō yiš·mā·‘ū
verses.literal: Hear . . . this O foolish and senseless . . . people who have eyes but do not see who have ears but do not hear

verses.original: הַאוֹתִ֨י לֹא־ תִירָ֜אוּ נְאֻם־ יְהֹוָ֗ה אִ֤ם לֹ֣א תָחִ֔ילוּ מִפָּנַי֙ אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֤מְתִּי חוֹל֙ גְּב֣וּל לַיָּ֔ם עוֹלָ֖ם חָק־ וְלֹ֣א יַעַבְרֶ֑נְהוּ גַלָּ֖יו וַיִּֽתְגָּעֲשׁוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יוּכָ֔לוּ וְהָמ֥וּ וְלֹ֥א יַעַבְרֻֽנְהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ō·w·ṯî lō- ṯî·rā·’ū nə·’um- Yah·weh ’im lō ṯā·ḥî·lū mip·pā·nay ’ă·šer- śam·tî ḥō·wl gə·ḇūl lay·yām ‘ō·w·lām ḥāq- wə·lō ya·‘aḇ·ren·hū ḡal·lāw way·yiṯ·gā·‘ă·šū wə·lō yū·ḵā·lū wə·hā·mū wə·lō ya·‘aḇ·run·hū
verses.literal: - Do you not fear Me declares the LORD Do you not tremble before Me the One who set the sand as the boundary for the sea an enduring barrier it cannot cross The waves surge but they cannot prevail They roar but cannot cross it

verses.original: הַזֶּה֙ וְלָעָ֤ם הָיָ֔ה סוֹרֵ֣ר וּמוֹרֶ֑ה לֵ֖ב סָ֖רוּ וַיֵּלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: haz·zeh wə·lā·‘ām hā·yāh sō·w·rêr ū·mō·w·reh lêḇ sā·rū way·yê·lê·ḵū
verses.literal: But these people have stubborn and rebellious hearts They have turned aside and gone away

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ אָמְר֣וּ בִלְבָבָ֗ם נִ֤ירָא נָא֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ הַנֹּתֵ֗ן גֶּ֛שֶׁם וְיֹרֶה וּמַלְק֖וֹשׁ בְּעִתּ֑וֹ יִשְׁמָר־ לָֽנוּ׃ חֻקּ֥וֹת שְׁבֻע֛וֹת קָצִ֖יר
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ’ā·mə·rū ḇil·ḇā·ḇām nî·rā nā ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū han·nō·ṯên ge·šem wə·yō·rɛh ū·mal·qō·wōš bə·‘it·tōw yiš·mār- lā·nū ḥuq·qō·wṯ šə·ḇu·‘ō·wṯ qā·ṣîr
verses.literal: They have not said in their hearts Let us fear . . . - the LORD our God who gives the rains both autumn and spring in season who keeps for us the appointed weeks of harvest

verses.original: עֲוֺנוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם הִטּוּ־ אֵ֑לֶּה וְחַטֹּ֣אותֵיכֶ֔ם מָנְע֥וּ מִכֶּֽם׃ הַטּ֖וֹב
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·wō·nō·w·ṯê·ḵem hiṭ·ṭū- ’êl·leh wə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯê·ḵem mā·nə·‘ū mik·kem haṭ·ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: Your iniquities have diverted these from you your sins have deprived you of My bounty

verses.original: כִּי־ נִמְצְא֥וּ בְעַמִּ֖י רְשָׁעִ֑ים יָשׁוּר֙ יְקוּשִׁ֔ים כְּשַׁ֣ךְ הִצִּ֥יבוּ מַשְׁחִ֖ית יִלְכֹּֽדוּ׃ אֲנָשִׁ֥ים
verses.transliteration: kî- nim·ṣə·’ū ḇə·‘am·mî rə·šā·‘îm yā·šūr yə·qū·šîm kə·šaḵ hiṣ·ṣî·ḇū maš·ḥîṯ yil·kō·ḏū ’ă·nā·šîm
verses.literal: For among My people are wicked men they watch like fowlers lying in wait they set a trap to catch men

verses.original: כִּכְלוּב֙ מָ֣לֵא ע֔וֹף כֵּ֥ן בָּתֵּיהֶ֖ם מְלֵאִ֣ים מִרְמָ֑ה עַל־ כֵּ֥ן גָּדְל֖וּ וַֽיַּעֲשִֽׁירוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kiḵ·lūḇ mā·lê ‘ō·wp̄ kên bāt·tê·hem mə·lê·’îm mir·māh ‘al- kên gā·ḏə·lū way·ya·‘ă·šî·rū
verses.literal: Like cages full of birds so their houses are full of deceit Therefore . . . they have become powerful and rich

verses.original: שָׁמְנ֣וּ עָשְׁת֗וּ גַּ֚ם עָֽבְר֣וּ דִבְרֵי־ רָ֔ע לֹא־ דִּ֣ין דָ֔נוּ דִּ֥ין יָת֖וֹם וְיַצְלִ֑יחוּ לֹ֥א שָׁפָֽטוּ׃ וּמִשְׁפַּ֥ט אֶבְיוֹנִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: šā·mə·nū ‘ā·šə·ṯū gam ‘ā·ḇə·rū ḏiḇ·rê- rā‘ lō- dîn ḏā·nū dîn yā·ṯō·wm wə·yaṣ·lî·ḥū lō šā·p̄ā·ṭū ū·miš·paṭ ’eḇ·yō·w·nîm
verses.literal: They have grown fat and sleek and have excelled in the deeds of the wicked They have not taken up the cause . . . . . . of the fatherless that they might prosper nor have they defended the rights of the needy

verses.original: לֹֽא־ אֶפְקֹ֖ד הַֽעַל־ אֵ֥לֶּה נְאֻם־ יְהֹוָ֑ה אִ֚ם לֹ֥א תִתְנַקֵּ֖ם נַפְשִֽׁי׃ס בְּג֣וֹי אֲשֶׁר־ כָּזֶ֔ה
verses.transliteration: lō- ’ep̄·qōḏ ha·‘al- ’êl·leh nə·’um- Yah·weh ’im lō ṯiṯ·naq·qêm nap̄·šî bə·ḡō·w ’ă·šer- kā·zeh
verses.literal: Should I not punish them for these things? declares the LORD Should I not avenge Myself on such a nation - as this

verses.original: שַׁמָּה֙ וְשַׁ֣עֲרוּרָ֔ה נִהְיְתָ֖ה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: šam·māh wə·ša·‘ă·rū·rāh nih·yə·ṯāh bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: A horrible and shocking thing has happened in the land

verses.original: הַנְּבִיאִ֞ים נִבְּא֣וּ־ בַשֶּׁ֗קֶר וְהַכֹּהֲנִים֙ יִרְדּ֣וּ עַל־ יְדֵיהֶ֔ם וְעַמִּ֖י אָ֣הֲבוּ כֵ֑ן וּמַֽה־ תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ לְאַחֲרִיתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: han·nə·ḇî·’îm nib·bə·’ū- ḇaš·še·qer wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm yir·dū ‘al- yə·ḏê·hem wə·‘am·mî ’ā·hă·ḇū ḵên ū·mah- ta·‘ă·śū lə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯāh
verses.literal: The prophets prophesy falsely and the priests rule by their own authority My people love it so but what will you do in the end
